test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who regards the whole world as his country
solution:
The solution is **Cosmopolitan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used for 'A person who regards the whole world as his country' is Cosmopolitan.
 
• For example - "cosmopolitans who spoke both Spanish and English"
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Convalescent - **Person recovering from an illness or medical treatment.
 
• **Countryman - **A person from the same country as someone else.
 
• **Metropolitan - **Relating to or denoting a metropolis or large city.
